content:
Guest vs signed-in

Explain which actions work signed out vs require sign-in (e.g. voice transcription and cloud routing per product rules).

What this is

Guests can try limited assistant flows. Signed-in users get full routing, voice, persisted chat history keyed to your user id, and plan-aware token display.

How to use it

  • Use the assistant signed out to read marketing copy or try constrained demos.
  • Sign in from the Auth screen when you hit a paywall or “please sign in” message.
  • Sign out returns you to auth; local-only artifacts may remain until cleared.

Notes and limits

Exact guest allowances change with product policy; trust in-product messages over static docs.
